assertions.assertion: The claim was for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The denial was issued under Reason Code CO-197
CO-197 indicates precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's condition
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
Dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded as I25.10
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes may be contributing to the patient's symptomatic episodes
